api.timeout: Request timed out ({{target}} did not respond within {{seconds}} seconds); the request was canceled. Check the service status and try again.
api.networkError: Cannot connect to {{target}} ({{base}}). Check the server address and make sure the local client is running.
api.excelTemplateFailed: Failed to generate the Excel template
api.pluginTooLarge: The plugin package exceeds the size limit (about 64 MB max).

printerStatus.headOpen: Printhead is open; close the printhead.
printerStatus.paperJam: Paper jam; open the cover, clear it and retry.
printerStatus.ribbonOut: Ribbon is used up; replace the ribbon.
printerStatus.otherError: Printer reports another error (0x80); check the printer.
printerStatus.paused: Paused; press the printer's pause key to resume.
printerStatus.driverNoStatus: Driver mode cannot read printer status (treated as online).
printerStatus.unsupported: The current transport does not support status queries.
printerStatus.emptyResponse: Connected to the printer, but no status response was returned (the printer may not answer status queries when paper is out, media is exhausted, or the printhead is open).
printerStatus.timeout: Status query timed out (no response for {{sec}} s from {{target}}) — the printer may be offline, out of paper, or the printhead may be open.
printerStatus.tsplNoResponse: TSPL printer did not respond to the status query ({{target}}).
printerStatus.tsplReadFailed: Failed to read TSPL printer status ({{target}}): {{reason}}
printerStatus.zebraReadFailed: Failed to read Zebra printer status ({{target}}): {{reason}}
printerStatus.truncated: Status response is incomplete and cannot be parsed (first line has only {{fields}} fields, expected at least 3).

transport.nativeModeTitle: In native command mode the printer renders with its own fonts and commands; the on-screen preview (image-based) no longer represents the actual printout
transport.nativeModeHint: No preview in native command mode; actual output depends on the printer
